source.text: All entries › Node.js Copy as Markdown Copied ← → Node.js You might say The terminal says command not found: node. Why can't my project run? The environment that lets JavaScript run directly on a computer, and the runtime behind build tools and AI dev tools·When running build scripts or starting modern web projects in a terminal, Node.js provides the runtime that executes JavaScript outside a browser. Beyond handling web page clicks, JavaScript runs server APIs and dev tools via Node.js; project warnings like 'requires Node 18+' mean you must verify your local runtime version first.
